data.raw_text:
UPDATE SA SUNOG SA DPWH BUILDING SA QC

Tiniyak ng Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) na walang dokumentong may kinalaman sa flood control probe ang nadamay sa sunog sa Bureau of Research and Standards (BRS) building sa Quezon City nitong Miyerkules, Oct. 22.

Wala rin daw mga empleyadong nasaktan sa insidente.

Ayon sa ahensya, nagmula ang sunog sa computer unit sa Materials Testing Division na umano'y sumabog.

Wala rin daw mga empleyadong nasaktan sa insidente. Ayon sa ahensya, nagmula ang sunog sa computer unit sa Materials Testing Division na umano'y sumabog.
data.english_translation: DPH BUILDING IN QC THE Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) confirms that no document dealing with a flood control probe has been burned by the Bureau of Research and Standards (BRS) building at the Quezon City of Wednesday, Oct 22. claims that neither employees injured in the incident. According to the agency, the computer unit came from the Material Testing Division as it was said to have exploded.
